subject: McGlynn School Investigation and Teacher Relations
overview: The committee addressed significant tensions following a police investigation into a gun clip found at McGlynn Middle School, resulting in a public apology from the Superintendent. The meeting also covered middle school enrollment imbalances, the rejection of school choice, and several departmental budget reports.

items.title: Student Recognition
items.summary: Recognized students for a video project and discussed successes in the district's vocational programs.

items.title: McGlynn Middle School Investigation and Teacher Response
items.summary: The Medford Teachers Association and McGlynn faculty refuted theories in a police report regarding a gun clip incident, demanding an apology for statements suggesting teachers may have staged the event.

items.title: Superintendent Apology and Police Testimony
items.summary: Superintendent Belson apologized to faculty for any offense caused by his statements to investigators, while Police Chief Sacco testified that Belson was open with police and accepted blame for reporting delays.

items.title: Community Engagement and Succession Planning
items.summary: Parents questioned the transparency of the Superintendent's contract extension and called for a formal succession plan to ensure stability during administrative transitions.

items.title: School Choice Recommendation
items.summary: Approved the recommendation to reject school choice for the 2018-2019 school year due to insufficient state reimbursement and capacity concerns.

items.title: Middle School Enrollment and Selection
items.summary: Tabled a report on middle school enrollment to allow for further recruitment efforts before implementing a partial lottery to address a significant seat imbalance between the Andrews and McGlynn schools.

items.title: Athletic Trainer Policy and MIAA Report
items.summary: Placed on file a report regarding trainer coverage for soccer games following a student injury, noting that the MIAA does not mandate trainers for soccer.

items.title: Lesley University Partnership
items.summary: Referred a proposed partnership with Lesley University regarding athletic facility upgrades and academic collaboration to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: ALICE Program Feedback
items.summary: Placed on file a report summarizing staff feedback on the ALICE emergency response training and planned for further site visits to observe drills in other districts.

items.title: Mathematics Pre-Budget Report and Gift Acceptance
items.summary: Approved a $3,000 gift from the J.S. Lim Foundation for student awards and placed the mathematics pre-budget report on file.

items.title: Health and Physical Education Pre-Budget Report
items.summary: Placed on file a report highlighting new yoga and lifeguard programs and the request for an adaptive physical education teacher.

items.title: Financial and Community Schools Reports
items.summary: Placed on file the general financial report and revolving account updates, noting budgetary pressures from security overtime and transportation costs.
